name: Toei 80s shonen
summary: Bold-outlined 1980s Toei TV cels of macho posed figures with muscle lines, gleaming metal, glowing auras and speed-line or starburst backdrops.

traits.line: bold dark outlines with heavy muscle-definition lines (Masami Suda on Fist of the North Star; Shingo Araki and Michi Himeno on Saint Seiya); Dragon Ball rounder and simpler
traits.shading: hard two-tone cel shadow, extra hard tone on muscles and armour; airbrushed glow outlines around fighters
traits.palette: saturated primaries and secondaries; gold, silver and bronze armour; post-apocalyptic ochre and dusk orange; deep blue night
traits.lighting: dramatic backlight, aura glow outlines, sparkle glints on metal
traits.faces: square jaws, thick brows, intense narrow eyes, rugged macho features; Saint Seiya elegant large-eyed bishonen
traits.backgrounds: flat painted skies and wastelands; abstract speed-line, starburst and flash backdrops in impact moments
traits.texture: cel dust, soft film grain, airbrush
traits.camera: held striking poses, impact freeze frames, repeated shots

style_words: 1980s Toei TV cel animation, as in Fist of the North Star (1984) and Saint Seiya (1986): bold dark outlines with heavy muscle-definition lines, hard two-tone cel shading, saturated primaries, gleaming gold and silver metallic highlights, airbrushed aura glow outlines, speed-line and starburst backdrops, flat painted skies, cel dust and soft film grain.
avoid: modern Dragon Ball Super digital gloss
